_README: ILLUSTRATIVE AND DISABLED BY DEFAULT. This is a template, not an approved release standard.
'enabled' is false: the gate returns NOT_CONFIGURED until someone deliberately chooses thresholds.
The two example numbers below (20% net savings, 1pp accuracy decline) come from the task brief
as illustrations. Meeting them does NOT constitute release certification.
Application-specific floors, sample requirements, and critical-category limits are left unset
on purpose - choose them explicitly for your workload before enabling this file.

_notes.non_inferiority: max_accuracy_decline_pp is checked against the LOWER bound of the bootstrap 95% interval for the accuracy delta, not the point estimate.
_notes.token_exactness: min_net_input_savings requires token_count_source in {provider_usage, exact_local_tokenizer}. Approximate local-template counts force INCONCLUSIVE.
_notes.no_composite_score: Checks are never combined into a single weighted score.
_notes.critical_categories: Populate max_category_regressions with e.g. {"negation": 0, "literal_fidelity": 0} once you decide which failures are unacceptable.
